title: Israeli strikes kill at least four in Khan Younis, Al-Mussadar and Gaza City's Tel Al-Hawa
detail: Medics say two airstrikes in Khan Younis killed two people and wounded six, a third person was killed in Al-Mussadar, and a vehicle strike in Gaza City's Tel Al-Hawa brought the day's toll to at least four. The Israeli military said it carried out two strikes on Palestinian militants without further detail. Toll reports vary by outlet (three to four). Hamas denies rebuilding its arsenal and accuses Israel of undermining the ceasefire; Gaza health officials count about 1,580 killed since the October 2025 truce.

media.caption: Israeli strikes kill four people in Gaza, medics say
